details:
The new Social/Friends List looks bad in my and other's opinion.

Removing the ability to look at the Avatar Details in the big menu is also a bad step since if someone will gatekeep a public avatar and the person that asked them if they can have the avatar doesn't know that they can look at the details of the avatar in the small menu profile is a bad idea giving avatar gate keepers an upper hand.

The new Nameplates look bad and also can make the banner of the group being represented look bad, for example: "verified _____" group's banners will be looking worse due to being obstruced by the: Group name, Shield and Avatar Quality Mark. And adding the tablet and phone onto the Name Plate is pointless since when you opened the Launch Pad you could see either: "Android", "IOS" or just nothing indicating the person is on a computer

"Android" - Meta Quest, Pico or and Mobile Device that operates on the Android Operating System

"IOS" - Device operating the Apple Operating System

Blank - Computer running Windows Operating System

Also due to this update inviting people if they crash got broken due to being unable to invite them if they're online and a Pop Up on the bottom of the menu saying "Unable to invite user. User is currently offline" causing the person requiring to send an "Invite Request" to join back.

The new Profile User Interface looks far too "website like" which I personally dislike as I didn't mind it looking like that and due to this change the fact that the whole Bio has to now be expanded and in this I shall also bring back what I spoke of before that being the lack of the "Avatar Details" button on the profile menu

So my idea is: Keep the Profile Customisation and turn everything as to how it was before.

Thank you for reading this post and I wish you all a good day or night.
title: The new UI is bad
